title: El techo
goal: Help patch a roof with a man who explains nothing
culture: He does not explain because the job explains itself and because he is on a roof. Every line he says to you is an imperative, and your whole part is understanding them fast and saying so. This is the listening mission of the district.

beats.objective: Check he means you should come up
beats.en: You want me to come up?
beats.good: Súbase from him, que me suba from you. Repeating an instruction back as a question is how you work with somebody who explains nothing.

beats.es: Sí pues. Ahora páseme esa lámina.
beats.objective: This one — and say it is coming
beats.good: Páseme — pass me. Ya se la paso is the answer, and ya does the whole tense on its own: I am doing it now.

beats.objective: One word, with your hand on the spot
beats.good: One word said as a question, with your hand where you think he means. On a roof that is worth more than a sentence.

beats.es: Ahí. Quieto, quieto... ya. Ya quedó.
beats.good: Quieto is hold still and there is nothing rude in it. Ya lo tengo is the only thing he needs to hear, because it means he can let go.
